prs.title: [svg-aam] Fix name of ED parameter in ReSpec config
prs.author: tidoust
prs.body:
🚀 **Netlify Preview**:
🔄 **this PR updates the following specs**:
- [svg-aam preview](https://deploy-preview-2913--wai-aria.netlify.app/svg-aam/index.html) — [svg-aam diff](https://services.w3.org/htmldiff?doc1=https%3A%2F%2Fw3c.github.io%2Fsvg-aam%2F&doc2=https%3A%2F%2Fdeploy-preview-2913--wai-aria.netlify.app%2Fsvg-aam%2Findex.html)

Follow-up to #2909 to fix a hiccup I had overlooked.

The spec used a setting named `ED` to set the URL of the Editor's Draft, which does not exist in ReSpec, instead of `edDraftURI`. This fixes the setting name.
